Roger Williams marks Navy birthday and discusses economic policy on social media
U.S. Congressman Rep. Roger Williams posted about honoring the U.S. Navy's birthday, advocating for economic freedom over socialism, and attending a local festival in Texas on October 13–14, 2026
Rep. Roger Williams, U.S. Congressman from Texas, shared several updates on his official Twitter account in mid-October 2026, addressing topics ranging from military appreciation to economic policy and community engagement.
On October 13, 2026, Williams marked the anniversary of the U.S. Navy by posting: "Happy Birthday to the United States Navy! Those who serve our nation in uniform do not do so for recognition. They serve because duty calls and their country needs them. Please join me in thanking our sailors for answering the call and defending our great nation."
Later that day, he commented on economic systems, stating, "While some in America look to socialism, countries that have lived under it for decades are moving in the opposite direction and choosing economic freedom. America must continue choosing the system that rewards hard work and gives people the freedom to build a better future."
On October 14, Williams highlighted his participation at a local event: "It was great to be back in Mineral Wells, TX, for the Crazy Water Festival! I enjoyed catching up with Scott and Carol Elder, visiting local vendors, and meeting Texans from across the area. Thank you to everyone who made this a great day in Mineral Wells."
Williams has represented Texas’s 25th congressional district since first winning election in 2012 against Elaine M. Henderson with 58.4% of the vote. He has consistently secured re-election victories over multiple cycles—including defeating Marco Montoya (2014), Kathi Thomas (2016), Julie Oliver (2018 and 2020), and Chad Hagg (2024)—often by significant margins.
